purpose: Generate pronunciation/listening/story/example MP3 files and embed them into exact audio elements. Popup meaning/IPA/UI behavior is already implemented inside the HTML and must not be changed.
instructions: Generate or obtain one natural English MP3 for each item.ttsText.
Read the MP3 bytes and Base64-encode them without line breaks.
Find item.audioSelector in item.targetHtmlFile and set only its src attribute to data:audio/mpeg;base64,<BASE64_MP3_BYTES>.
Do not change popup text, IPA, Persian meanings, layout, story text, exercises, selectors, IDs or navigation.
Do not add external URLs, fetch(), runtime TTS, CDN, ParsPack or GitHub dependencies.
The final deliverable must remain a single self-contained HTML file.

items.ttsText: She works at a bank every day.
They do not play tennis on Friday.

Every Saturday, Sara starts her day at seven. She opens the curtains, makes her bed, and washes her face. Her younger brother Adam usually wakes up later, but he always joins her for breakfast. Their mother prepares eggs, and Sara makes tea. The family talks about the week while they eat. At eight, Sara takes the bus to the school library. She volunteers there because she loves books and enjoys helping people. The bus stops near the main gate, so she walks through the garden. The library opens at nine, and Sara checks the return box before she starts her work. At ten, she helps a new student find the science books. The student asks where the history section is, and Sara shows him the correct shelf. She speaks slowly because he is learning English. She does not rush him, and she does not laugh when he makes a mistake. They read one short page together and look up three new words. At noon, Sara calls her mother from the garden. She tells her that the library is quiet and that she has finished her tasks. Her mother usually asks her to buy bread on the way home, but today they already have enough. After lunch, Sara visits her grandmother. They drink tea, share a small cake, and talk about old family photos. Sara sometimes writes the stories in her notebook. She returns home before sunset and writes in her notebook. At night, she sets her alarm and puts her book beside the bed. She does these things every Saturday, so the day feels full but peaceful.

items.meaningShownByHtml: قبل از این / قبلاً؛ برای اشاره به زمانی پیش از اکنون یا پیش از رخداد دیگر.
مشغول؛ وقتی فرد درگیر کار یا فعالیت‌های زیادی است.
قهوه؛ نوشیدنی تهیه‌شده از دانهٔ قهوه.
هر؛ برای اشاره به تک‌تک اعضای یک مجموعه یا تکرار منظم.
دوست؛ فردی که رابطهٔ صمیمی و غیرخانوادگی با او داریم.
خوشحال؛ دارای حس رضایت، شادی یا حال خوب.
خانه؛ محل زندگی و جایی که فرد آن را فضای شخصی و خانوادگی خود می‌داند.
موسیقی؛ ترکیبی سازمان‌یافته از صدا، ریتم و ملودی.
اکنون؛ همین لحظه یا بازهٔ زمانی بسیار نزدیک به حال.
پارک؛ فضای عمومی سبز برای قدم‌زدن، استراحت و تفریح.
تلفن؛ وسیلهٔ ارتباطی برای تماس، پیام و استفاده از خدمات دیجیتال.
آماده؛ در وضعیتی که برای انجام کار یا شروع رویداد آمادگی وجود دارد.
مدرسه؛ محیط رسمی آموزش برای دانش‌آموزان.

خسته؛ وقتی انرژی جسمی یا ذهنی کاهش یافته و فرد به استراحت نیاز دارد.
معمولاً؛ برای کاری که در بیشتر مواقع یا طبق عادت رخ می‌دهد.
